# POMNI

POMNI is an online service for personal notes, nested folders, knowledge graph links, and task planning.

## Site purpose

Use this site information to understand POMNI as a personal knowledge base and productivity tool.

POMNI helps users write Markdown notes, organize nested folders, connect knowledge in a visual graph, link tasks to notes, plan work in week, calendar, list, and Kanban views, and receive optional browser deadline reminders.
